labor.task: Shop: handrails 92 LF + 22 posts, returns, vent holes

Shop: 6 bench pipe supports + plates; drill 36 slats
Field: core drill 22 handrail post holes
Field: set posts, grout, install rails 92 LF
Field: guardrail cores, set & grout 3 panels
Field: anchor bench supports, install slats (3 benches)

scope.title: Handrails at play-area ramp and stairs (Tag ER, 4/L4.2; 2/L4.3)
scope.text: Fabricate and install approx. 92 LF of single-rail metal pipe handrail, 1-1/2" Sch 40 pipe (ASTM A53), both sides of the curved accessible ramp (~64 LF, rails rolled to ramp radius) and at four stair runs (~28 LF), 12" extensions, 22 posts core-drilled 4" dia and set in non-shrink grout with #4 U-bar; hot-dip galvanized after fabrication, vent holes per SPR Std. 05 52 13_3; slip joints at 50' max.

scope.title: Metal guardrail at retaining wall (3/L4.3, SPR Std. 05 52 13.29)
scope.text: Fabricate and install approx. 20 LF of 3'-6" picket guardrail along the curved retaining wall: 1-1/2" Sch 40 posts and top/bottom rails (rolled), 3/4" Sch 40 pickets at 4" max clear, posts set in 3" dia cores with non-shrink grout; hot-dip galvanized after fabrication.

scope.title: Double-backed benches (Tag BB, 5/L4.2, SPR Std. 32 13 73.12)
scope.text: Fabricate 3 double-backed benches with hot-dip galvanized steel pipe bench supports (2 per 6' bench) and base plates, 2x4 Douglas Fir select structural slats with galvanized carriage bolts; bolt down to 4" concrete slab (slab by others).

scope.title: Restroom gate modifications (A4/A2.0, A5/A2.0)
scope.text: Modify 2 existing steel restroom gates to be re-used: door-lever pass-thru, cane bolt/drop rod with welded guide brackets, slide latch, (4) welded steel hinges per gate, fit within steel gate frame; core hole for drop rod. Field painting by SPR paint shop.

scope.title: Submittals and compliance
scope.text: Shop drawings (required before fabrication), product data, galvanizing certification, L&I Intents/Affidavits and certified payroll.

exclusions: Play equipment and custom swings, play signs, picnic tables, standard waste cans, wear mats, safety surfacing.
Concrete ramps, retaining walls, slabs, curbs and paving; restroom doors/frames (HM), stainless steel wall panels and countertop (by GC), toilet accessories and grab bars.
Painting of gates and frames (SPR paint shop), bronze dog statue relocation, landscape add-alternate items.
Performance & payment bond (add 1.5% if required), Washington retail sales tax (collected by prime per WAC 458-20-171), permits.
Quantities scaled from L3.1 (1/8"=1'-0") and 2/L4.3 (1/4"=1'-0"); field-verify lengths before fabrication.
